image_description: A close-up, high-contrast black and white image of a metallic breastplate. The armor features a central vertical ridge, flared lower edges, and visible rivets or attachment points near the top shoulders. The surface appears textured with speckles, suggesting either aged metal, a specific artistic filter, or digital noise.

This looks like digital noise or a generative texture artifact rather than realistic metal pitting or grain, which typically varies in density and size. It reduces the realism of the material.

The lower flared sections of the armor appear slightly soft and ill-defined where they meet the white background. The geometry seems to lose rigidity, lacking the sharp, hard edge expected of steel plate armor.
